intro.text: Shallan's sketchbook is the portfolio in which Shallan Davar keeps her sketches and drawings.

items.text: After the attack on the Wind's Pleasure, Shallan found a single drawing of Jasnah in a trunk saved from the ship and mourned the loss of all her other sketches.
Travelling with a caravan, she began filling an old notebook of Jasnah's with new drawings to replace what she had lost.
